latest_release.name: v2.2.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps): update eslint-plugin-react-hooks and fix linting issues by @satnaing in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/233
* refactor: enhance tables and update table layout by @satnaing in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/234
* fix: add missing space in profile form by @satnaing in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/235
* style: apply variant 'destructive' to sign-out buttons by @jaycodev in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/236
* fix: prevent navigation to 500 page during development by @satnaing in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/240
* build(deps-dev): bump vite from 7.1.9 to 7.1.11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/242
* fix(style): update data attribute class in authenticated layout by @satnaing in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/249

## New Contributors
* @jaycodev made their first contribution in https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/pull/236

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1
